why: The phone as each variant run has it (WORKLIST P0.86): each name's adb shell commands set before the run touches the phone and put back once it ends, so nothing outlives its run. Where the phone's own value is not a fixed default, `read` takes it first (the last word of its answer, which must match `answer`) and a reset's {was} puts it back. `ready`, for a setting the system takes a while to apply, is asked until it answers yes (exit 0). `flows`: the run takes every flow before the route walk, on three machines; every other variant walks the routes alone, on one. `judges`: what else fails the run on that phone (cut-text: e2e/cut-text-judges.mjs). run-flows.sh runs them (e2e/variants.mjs); variants.test.ts holds every one to a setup, a reset and a reason.

plain.why: The phone as every run has it: the walk's captures every other variant is read against.

motion-on.why: Android's transitions and animations at 1, as most members have them: every other run has them at 0, which React Native and Reanimated read as Reduce Motion. The window animation stays 0, because one holds injected keys.

largest-text.why: The largest text Android offers a member (font scale 2).

bold-text.why: Bold text, as Android's accessibility setting gives it. Its cut text is not judged here: React Native measures a Text with a paint that does not carry this setting while Android draws with it, so every measure the app can make of its own lines is wrong at bold text (runs 39004285239, 39010071533, 39016139854: "E2E_WRITER", drawn whole, measured cut every time). What is cut at bold text is read from the screen itself, by WORKLIST P2.7's position reader.

narrowest.why: The narrowest width a member's phone can be, under 320 dp: the emulator's 1080 px at density 560 is 308 dp.

three-button.why: Android's three-button navigation bar, taller than the gesture bar every other run has.

right-to-left.why: The phone in Arabic (Iraq), as a member who reads Arabic has it: Android lays every app out right to left. The language is the system's own, set as root with the system restarted, and the language the phone had is put back the same way.
ready: cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER com.reelhouse.society | grep -q com.reelhouse.society/

dark.why: The system in dark mode. The emulator every other run uses is in light mode (run 39013202388 read "no" before a light run set "no", so that run changed nothing): the plain run is the light system, and this one the dark, so the app is seen in both. The app keeps its own grounds either way. The mode the phone had is read first and put back.

tablet.why: A tablet's width: the emulator's 1080 px at density 210 is 823 dp across, wider than Android's 600 dp line for a large screen and the reading column's 560, so every flow runs with each page and sheet held to the column, centred in a window wider than any phone.
